description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractEvaluator for parsing and evaluating infix expressions, supporting functions, constants, operators, brackets, and variables within a thread-safe environment. It handles tokenization, parsing, and evaluation strategies, serving as a base for creating concrete evaluators.

classes.name: AbstractEvaluator
classes.description: An abstract Java class for evaluating infix expressions with support for functions, constants, operators, brackets, and variables. Thread-safe and extendable for custom evaluation logic.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression string, optionally with a context, returning a value of type T.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported operators.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported functions.

methods.name: getConstants
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported constants.

methods.name: getPosftfixExpression
methods.description: Returns the postfix expression as a string, based on the internal RPN stack.
